desc: Identify and prove the path-prefix cut characterization of strong connectivity.
Derive the permutation formulation and inclusion-exclusion recurrence for prefix-max constraints.
Implement the CDQ/NTT recurrence algorithm and pass all three public samples.
Cross-check the implementation against exhaustive pairing enumeration for every valid color string at small N (including boundary cases), comparing modulo counts to the program’s result.
Validate runtime and memory usage of the Python NTT/CDQ implementation at or near \(N=2\times10^5\).
